name: get_plugin_config
description: Read an installed plugin's custom-config record -- the matching read side of configure_plugin. Call list_installed_plugins first to get the real plugin_id. Call this before configure_plugin: for key='customtypedparams', to learn a plugin's typed-params schema (field names/types/isRequired/isList/params) before trying to set 'customtypeddata'; for 'customtypeddata', to read the current values before modifying them, since their exact shape isn't guaranteed to be a flat object -- send back whatever shape this returns, modified, rather than constructing one from scratch. This only applies to plugin-backed capabilities -- never call it for a native Insteon/Z-Wave/Zigbee/Matter device.

key.description: Which custom record to read. Defaults to 'customparams'. 'customtypedparams' reads a plugin's own typed-params schema (safe to read even though only the plugin itself may write it). 'customtypeddata' reads the customer-entered values matching that schema. 'oauth' reads the OAuth config (client_id/client_secret are never returned as real secrets by the host).
